title: BRAF mutations and the association of V600E with CD133 and CDX2 expression in a Pakistani colorectal carcinoma cohort.
authors: Hassan, Sobia; Mirza, Talat; Khatoon, Ambrina; Bukhari, Uzma; Shaikh, Fouzia; Karim, Asad
one_liner_zh: 该研究主要基于Sanger测序和免疫组化分析巴基斯坦结直肠癌中BRAF V600E突变及其与CD133/CDX2表达的关联，仅含少量同源建模和对接，核心非蛋白质-DNA互作，且无AI或MD方法，与本课题关系微弱。
abstract: BACKGROUND: Despite a high incidence of colorectal carcinoma, data regarding genetic aberrations in colorectal carcinoma (CRC) patients in Pakistan is scarce. This study aimed to determine the frequency of BRAFV600E mutations in colorectal carcinoma tissue in the Pakistani population and to associate BRAFV600E expression with CD133, a marker of colorectal stem cells, and CDX2 marker of differentiation. METHODS: Sanger Sequencing of exon 15 (426 bp) including the hotspot V600E was performed on formalin-fixed-paraffin-embedded (FFPE) CRC tissue samples of 115 patients. The samples were subjected to immunohistochemistry (IHC) to assess the expression of BRAFV600E, CDX2, and CD133. Additionally, homology modelling and docking were performed to investigate novel deletions revealed in sequencing. RESULTS: Twenty-four (20.8%) BRAF variants were identified in the coding region, with V600E mutations detected in 14 (12.2% )cases (GenBank: PP003258.1; Pop Set: 2678087296). Moreover, a wide spectrum of novel non-V600E mutations (8.6%) were identified, including deletions and missense variations. In-silico analysis revealed that due to large deletions in the coding region of three samples, the affinity of the anti-BRAF drugs (Encorafenib and Vemurafenib) for the active site decreased in comparison to the wild type. The IHC analysis showed that BRAFV600E expression was significantly associated with CD133 expression (chi(2)((1, n=115)) = 26.351; p = < 0.001) and with CDX2 expression (chi(2)((1, n=115)) = 14.88; p = 0.001). Multivariate analysis using binary logistic regression revealed association of BRAFV600E mutations with age (OR = 1.123; CI = 1.024-1.232; p = 0.014), gender (OR = 0.071; CI = 0.006-0.831; p = 0.035), grade (0.007; CI = 0-0.644) and CD133 expression (OR = 65.649; CI = 2.153-2001.556; p = 0.016). CONCLUSION: The present study demonstrates a notably high V600E frequency (12.2%) in comparison to global reported data, which ranges from 0.4 to 18%. This finding reflects the importance of upfront BRAF testing of the genetically distinct population of Pakistan. Previously unreported mutations identified in the sample may be of clinical significance and warrant further investigation. The concomitant high expression and significant association between CD133 and BRAFV600E represent vital actionable genes that may be targeted together to improve CRC patient management.
abstract_zh: 背景：尽管结直肠癌发病率较高，但巴基斯坦结直肠癌（CRC）患者遗传畸变的数据稀缺。本研究旨在确定巴基斯坦人群中结直肠癌组织中BRAFV600E突变的频率，并将BRAFV600E表达与结直肠干细胞标志物CD133及分化标志物CDX2相关联。方法：对115例患者的福尔马林固定石蜡包埋（FFPE）CRC组织样本进行了包含热点V600E的外显子15（426 bp）的Sanger测序。样本接受免疫组织化学（IHC）以评估BRAFV600E、CDX2和CD133的表达。此外，进行了同源建模和对接以研究测序中揭示的新缺失。结果：在编码区鉴定出24个（20.8%）BRAF变异，其中14例（12.2%）检测到V600E突变（GenBank：PP003258.1；Pop Set：2678087296）。此外，鉴定出广泛的非V600E新突变（8.6%），包括缺失和错义变异。计算机模拟分析显示，由于三个样本编码区的大片段缺失，抗BRAF药物（Encorafenib和Vemurafenib）对活性位点的亲和力较野生型降低。IHC分析显示，BRAFV600E表达与CD133表达显著相关（chi(2)((1, n=115)) = 26.351；p = < 0.001），并与CDX2表达显著相关（chi(2)((1, n=115)) = 14.88；p = 0.001）。使用二元逻辑回归的多变量分析显示，BRAFV600E突变与年龄（OR = 1.123；CI = 1.024-1.232；p = 0.014）、性别（OR = 0.071；CI = 0.006-0.831；p = 0.035）、分级（0.007；CI = 0-0.644）和CD133表达（OR = 65.649；CI = 2.153-2001.556；p = 0.016）相关。结论：本研究显示V600E频率（12.2%）显著高于全球报告数据（范围为0.4%至18%）。这一发现反映了对巴基斯坦遗传特征独特人群进行前期BRAF检测的重要性。样本中鉴定出的先前未报告的突变可能具有临床意义，值得进一步研究。CD133与BRAFV600E之间的高表达和显著关联代表了关键的可操作基因，可共同靶向以改善CRC患者管理。
